# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# Define center of the schematic (A4 sheet 210x297 mm, center at (105, 148.5))
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 105.0, 148.5

# Place the AP2112K-3.3 regulator at the center
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Regulator_Linear",
    symbol_name="AP2112K-3.3",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="U1",
    value="AP2112K-3.3",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place power symbols
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="+5V",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 60,
    pos_y=center_y_1 + 20,
    reference="#PWR_IN",
    value="+5V",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="+3V3",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 60,
    pos_y=center_y_1 + 20,
    reference="#PWR_OUT",
    value="+3V3",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="GND",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 30,
    pos_y=center_y_1 - 20,
    reference="#PWR_GND1",
    value="GND",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="GND",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 30,
    pos_y=center_y_1 - 20,
    reference="#PWR_GND2",
    value="GND",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place input decoupling capacitor C1 (1uF)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="C",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 30,
    pos_y=center_y_1 + 10,
    reference="C1",
    value="1uF",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# Place output decoupling capacitor C2 (1uF)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Device",
    symbol_name="C",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 30,
    pos_y=center_y_1 + 10,
    reference="C2",
    value="1uF",
    rotation=0,
    mirror="None"
)

# --- Connecting all wires in the Schematic ---

# Connect +5V power to U1 VIN pin
connect_pins("#PWR_IN", "1", "U1", "VIN")

# Connect U1 VIN to C1 pin 1
connect_pins("U1", "VIN", "C1", "1")

# Connect C1 pin 2 to GND (left side)
connect_pins("C1", "2", "#PWR_GND1", "1")

# Connect U1 GND pin to GND (left side)
connect_pins("U1", "GND", "#PWR_GND1", "1")

# Connect U1 VOUT pin to C2 pin 1
connect_pins("U1", "VOUT", "C2", "1")

# Connect C2 pin 2 to GND (right side)
connect_pins("C2", "2", "#PWR_GND2", "1")

# Connect U1 VOUT pin to +3V3 power symbol
connect_pins("U1", "VOUT", "#PWR_OUT", "1")

# Connect U1 GND pin to GND (right side) for completeness
connect_pins("U1", "GND", "#PWR_GND2", "1")

write_out_all_wires()
